summary.text: John Larson represents Connecticut's 1st District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first elected to Congress in 1998.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in East Hartford, he taught history and coached football at George J. Penney High School and co-owned an insurance agency before entering politics.
He was elected to the Connecticut State Senate in 1982 and was Senate President Pro Tempore from 1987 to 1995.
He graduated from Central Connecticut State University in 1971 and lives in East Hartford.
